## aphrody

### `aphrody`

Crate `aphrody`, parser `crates/infra/aphrody-command/src/lib.rs#Cli`, 243 commands.

- `aphrody pure` — Pure commands (rag, toolcall, html, text): no network, no processes; also built for wasm32.
  - `aphrody pure rag` — RAG core: chunking, rank fusion, MMR, source weighting, retrieval eval.
    - `aphrody pure rag ops` — Manifest of the RAG call surface: ABI and every operation name.
    - `aphrody pure rag call` — Run a structured operation: `rag call rrf '{"lists":[[1,2],[2,3]]}'`.
    - `aphrody pure rag chunk` — Split a source file into line-addressed chunks.
  - `aphrody pure toolcall` — Tool-call JSON repair, validation and inline extraction.
    - `aphrody pure toolcall repair` — Repair malformed model-emitted JSON; prints `{"value", "repairs"}`.
    - `aphrody pure toolcall validate` — Validate arguments against a JSON-Schema subset; prints `{"violations"}`.
    - `aphrody pure toolcall extract` — Extract inline tool calls (Hermes, Qwen XML, Mistral, OpenAI, bare JSON).
  - `aphrody pure html` — HTML main-content extraction, Markdown conversion and SimHash.
    - `aphrody pure html dragon-ball` — Source-aware Dragon Ball projection as JSON, shared with native Web.
    - `aphrody pure html extract` — Main-content extraction as JSON (title, byline, Markdown, blocks, SimHash).
    - `aphrody pure html markdown` — Whole-document HTML to GitHub-flavoured Markdown.
    - `aphrody pure html simhash` — 64-bit SimHash of the text, as 16 hex digits.
  - `aphrody pure text` — Comment extraction, AI-marker scrubbing, Aphrody style and language detection.
    - `aphrody pure text comments` — Comments of a source file as JSON.
    - `aphrody pure text scrub` — Remove AI markers and emoji from a comment body.
    - `aphrody pure text aphrodify` — Apply the Aphrody prose style.
    - `aphrody pure text is-japanese` — Print `true` when the text contains Japanese characters.

- `aphrody infra probe` — Probe an HTTP or TCP endpoint health.
- `aphrody infra pipeline` — Execute declared monorepo validation stages.
- `aphrody infra serve` — Launch the embedded HTTP API daemon.
- `aphrody infra ssh` — Remote SSH operator: execute commands, audit host health, sysctl kernel tuning, port inspection.
  - `aphrody infra ssh pure` — Pure commands (rag, toolcall, html, text): no network, no processes; also built for wasm32.
    - `aphrody infra ssh pure rag` — RAG core: chunking, rank fusion, MMR, source weighting, retrieval eval.
      - `aphrody infra ssh pure rag ops` — Manifest of the RAG call surface: ABI and every operation name.
      - `aphrody infra ssh pure rag call` — Run a structured operation: `rag call rrf '{"lists":[[1,2],[2,3]]}'`.
      - `aphrody infra ssh pure rag chunk` — Split a source file into line-addressed chunks.
    - `aphrody infra ssh pure toolcall` — Tool-call JSON repair, validation and inline extraction.
      - `aphrody infra ssh pure toolcall repair` — Repair malformed model-emitted JSON; prints `{"value", "repairs"}`.
      - `aphrody infra ssh pure toolcall validate` — Validate arguments against a JSON-Schema subset; prints `{"violations"}`.
      - `aphrody infra ssh pure toolcall extract` — Extract inline tool calls (Hermes, Qwen XML, Mistral, OpenAI, bare JSON).
    - `aphrody infra ssh pure html` — HTML main-content extraction, Markdown conversion and SimHash.
      - `aphrody infra ssh pure html dragon-ball` — Source-aware Dragon Ball projection as JSON, shared with native Web.
      - `aphrody infra ssh pure html extract` — Main-content extraction as JSON (title, byline, Markdown, blocks, SimHash).
      - `aphrody infra ssh pure html markdown` — Whole-document HTML to GitHub-flavoured Markdown.
      - `aphrody infra ssh pure html simhash` — 64-bit SimHash of the text, as 16 hex digits.
    - `aphrody infra ssh pure text` — Comment extraction, AI-marker scrubbing, Aphrody style and language detection.
      - `aphrody infra ssh pure text comments` — Comments of a source file as JSON.
      - `aphrody infra ssh pure text scrub` — Remove AI markers and emoji from a comment body.
      - `aphrody infra ssh pure text aphrodify` — Apply the Aphrody prose style.
      - `aphrody infra ssh pure text is-japanese` — Print `true` when the text contains Japanese characters.
  - `aphrody infra ssh rag` — Index and retrieve local code and documentation. _(cfg: all(not(target_arch = "wasm32"), feature = "rag"))_
    - `aphrody infra ssh rag index` — Index a directory incrementally, including vectors when configured.
    - `aphrody infra ssh rag web-ingest` — Scrape one URL through Aphrody OS and index it in the local AI RAG store.
    - `aphrody infra ssh rag search` — Search the index and report source paths, lines and effective mode.
    - `aphrody infra ssh rag context` — Assemble source context for a model prompt.
    - `aphrody infra ssh rag stats` — Report document, chunk and vector counts.
  - `aphrody infra ssh gateway` — Serve or inspect the OpenAI-compatible HTTP AI Gateway (127.0.0.1:8795). _(cfg: not(target_arch = "wasm32"))_
    - `aphrody infra ssh gateway serve` — Start serving the OpenAI-compatible HTTP AI Gateway (default: 127.0.0.1:8795).
    - `aphrody infra ssh gateway status` — Query the status of a running gateway.
    - `aphrody infra ssh gateway models` — List models available through the gateway.
  - `aphrody infra ssh config` — Manage, show, or import Codex-compatible configuration. _(cfg: not(target_arch = "wasm32"))_
    - `aphrody infra ssh config show` — Show the active or effective resolved configuration.
    - `aphrody infra ssh config path` — Print the path to the user's config.toml file (~/.aphrody/config.toml).
    - `aphrody infra ssh config import-codex` — Import and layer configuration from ~/.codex/config.toml.

      - `aphrody infra ssh web dragon-ball discover` — Discover Google sources, media references and root technology evidence

    - `aphrody infra ssh re classify` — Classify a file's content type with Google Magika (deep-learning). _(cfg: feature = "magika")_
    - `aphrody infra ssh re go` — Analyse a Go binary — version, function table, packages, type names.

  - `aphrody infra ssh memory` — Memory: an application's local memory file (write, recall, list, delete, clear) and Tier-1 provider migration. _(cfg: not(target_arch = "wasm32"))_
    - `aphrody infra ssh memory write` — Store one memory; prints `{"id": …}`. An existing `--id` is replaced.
    - `aphrody infra ssh memory recall` — Records best matching `--query` (lexical); prints `{"records": [… "score"]}`.
    - `aphrody infra ssh memory list` — Records newest first; prints `{"records": […]}`.
    - `aphrody infra ssh memory delete` — Delete one record; prints `{"deleted": bool}`.
    - `aphrody infra ssh memory clear` — Delete every record of `--agent-id`; prints `{"deleted": n}`.
    - `aphrody infra ssh memory migrate` — Copy all records for `--agent-id` from one provider to another.

### `nie`

Crate `aphrody-nie-cli`, parser `crates/nie/aphrody-nie-cli/src/main.rs#Cli`, 209 commands.

- `nie play` — Lance l'exécution headless du moteur de jeu nie (simulation, menu, match, rendu).
- `nie net` — Mode multijoueur en ligne, matchmaking Inacode, simulation déterministe et ladder ranked.
  - `nie net server` — Start the standalone WebSocket multiplayer and matchmaking server.
  - `nie net room` — Inacode room creation and formatting.
    - `nie net room create` — Create a new Inacode room and print its details.
    - `nie net room format` — Formats or generates a canonical Inacode (`INA-XXXX`).
  - `nie net sim-match` — Run an automated 2-player deterministic match simulation with rollback verification.
  - `nie net challenge` — Shareable 8-character base-32 challenge link operations.
    - `nie net challenge create` — Create a new shareable 8-character base-32 challenge.
  - `nie net ladder` — Competitive ladder rankings and 11 official rank tiers.
  - `nie net clans` — Clan and club leaderboards.
  - `nie net calc-elo` — Calculate progressive directional ELO delta for a match.
- `nie mcp` — Start the native Model Context Protocol server on stdio.
- `nie computer-use` — Probe non-destructively the native `nie.exe` or Ghidra Computer Use surface.
- `nie mod` — Le cycle de modding complet : créer un mod, l'éditer, le valider, l'installer.
  - `nie mod init` — Crée un dossier de mod et son manifeste.
  - `nie mod add` — Fait entrer un ou plusieurs fichiers **vanilla** dans le mod, prêts à être édités.
  - `nie mod get` — Affiche un fichier du mod (ou son vanilla) en JSON, entier ou à un pointeur.
  - `nie mod set` — Modifie un champ et réencode le fichier dans le mod.
  - `nie mod texture` — Remplace une texture principale par un PNG ; les autres textures et les régions d'atlas du conteneur sont recopiées telles quelles.
  - `nie mod recolor` — Recolore un `.g4tx` sans toucher à sa géométrie : décalage TSV et/ou rampe de luminance.
  - `nie mod status` — Ce que le mod change, fichier par fichier, comparé au vanilla du VFS.
  - `nie mod validate` — Vérifie le manifeste, l'arborescence, et que chaque fichier se relit après encodage.
  - `nie mod install` — Installe le mod dans le jeu : sauvegarde le `cpk_list`, le réécrit, copie les fichiers.
  - `nie mod uninstall` — Rend au jeu son `cpk_list.cfg.bin` d'origine.
- `nie launcher` — Opérations du lanceur IEVR Ultimate Team (chiffrement équipe, conteneurs .utmod, parking de save).
